brief:
Palestinian families in Jiftlik, a village in the Jordan Valley, face renewed threats of violence and expulsion as Israeli settlers establish an outpost nearby, Middle East Eye reported. The community braces for potential displacement as the settler presence intensifies in the area.

The development marks an escalation of tensions in the Jordan Valley, where Palestinian communities have long faced pressure from Israeli settlement expansion and land seizures.

title: Settlers erect outpost near West Bank village, threatening Palestinian families with expulsion
